test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate title for the given passage.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses the alarming impact of human activities on animal life during the Anthropocene.
 
• It highlights the drastic decline in wildlife populations and the broader implications for the environment and human economy.
 
• The data provided by the WWF and the World Economic Forum underscores the need for immediate action.
 
• Other options such as "World Wildlife Fund and India" or "Animal Life in India" are too narrow in focus, while "Birds and their Life" does not cover the full scope of the passage.

Thus, the most fitting title for the passage is **Option 2: "Animals in the Anthropocene"**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "World Wildlife Fund and India"** – The passage discusses global wildlife decline rather than focusing on the WWF's activities in India.
 
• **Option 3: "Animal Life in India"** – The passage is about global trends in wildlife decline, not specific to India.
 
• **Option 4: "Birds and their Life"** – This option is too specific and does not encompass the broader themes of the passage.
